variables.label: API Endpoint
variables.description: Override the default API endpoint URL.

variables.name: temperature
variables.label: Temperature
variables.description: Controls randomness on compatible legacy Claude models. Current models use their default sampling behavior.

variables.name: max_tokens
variables.label: Max Tokens
variables.description: Maximum combined thinking and response tokens. Current Claude models may use part of this budget for adaptive thinking.

variables.name: top_p
variables.label: Top P
variables.description: Nucleus sampling for compatible legacy Claude models. Current models use their default sampling behavior.

variables.label: Stream Response
variables.description: Stream the response token by token.
